title: Fix gray bar of embed game window in Windows
body:
Fix https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113462

Please note that I'm not sure this is proper way to actually fix the problem, I suppose this is just a hack - see https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/113462#issuecomment-3734171045. But as 4.6 is in beta stage I suppose there is no time to search the root of the problem.
